11th June, 1947.

Helmut von RAUSCHENPLAT.

Helmut von RAUSCHENPLAT, during the war in the U.K., who returned last year to Germany, has joined the S.P.D. and has become Secretary of State for Wurttemburg; he has changed his name to EBERHARD.

R4.
